articles.author: Ajaya Legion
articles.description:
Everyone loves shouting about “AI innovation,” but here’s the part no one wants to admit:
It’s like buying instant noodles, putting them in a bowl, and bragging that you’re a chef.
Behind the scenes, the pattern is the same:
Download a pre-trained model
Call an API
Make a website
Raise millions
Pretend you’re the next big thing
Meanwhile, the real engineering happens in the companies building the actual models. Everyone else is basically remixing the same tool with different marketing.
The truth hurts, but it’s simple:
We don’t need another “AI note-taker,” “AI assistant,” or “AI productivity guru” pretending to be groundbreaking.
And yes, these startups can still succeed — but only if they stop hiding behind buzzwords and start solving real problems.
Because at some point, users will realize they’ve been paying premium rates for what is basically… a very enthusiastic middleman.
articles.title: The Brutal Truth About Today’s “AI Startups”: Most Are Just Fancy Wrappers Around Someone Else’s Model
